sections.title: the foundation fits a company introduction. *the workflow still needs proof.*
sections.lede: Karte can already collect public context, projects, answers, and inbound on one page. It does not yet ship company ownership, team roles, approval, or a validated repeated-company workflow.

sections.title: free today. *not a promise forever.*
sections.lede: There is no billing in the current product. Karte is free to use today, but the long-term commercial model is not committed.

items.a: No visitor account is required on a published profile. Chat answers from owner-supplied public memory and falls back safely when the AI path cannot respond.
Google sign-in opens the dashboard and owner-only settings. The owner controls content, appearance, memory, leads, analytics, and custom domains.

Links, projects, timeline, writing, and proof stay together on one owned page. Chat, direct contact, and optional page email preserve who asked and why. Optional encyclopedia, newspaper, and roast views reuse the same owner-supplied profile. Agent-type pages can publish operator, capability, disclosure, and machine-readable manifest data.

Karte’s gateway is the default; a profile owner can configure another provider key. Every feature starts with the same source: content the profile owner publishes or connects. AI is optional; the page is not.

closing.title: give the relevant visitor *a better first move.*
closing.note: No billing in the current product. Sign in only when you are ready to claim the page.

footer.summary: Live and maintained for personal use. Person and agent profiles ship today; company and team workflows remain the next validation.
footer.legal: PostHog and Microsoft Clarity measure only these static marketing pages; profiles, chat, contact, sign-in, and dashboard surfaces are excluded from Clarity session replay.
